bindings.name: Design system
bindings.origin: Declared by the Design and Pages templates; accepted by the owner
bindings.statement: Pages draws every page with Design's design system. Its Kit is a copy that Pages' kit adapter converts into the shape its canvas renders. Design leads; a change in Design reaches Pages' Kit automatically, and Pages proposes changes back as Work.
activity: Accent colour change copied to Pages' Kit

bindings.name: The people we design for
bindings.origin: Proposed by Work W-31, “Compare specs: Personas' spec changed”, done by an agent
bindings.statement: Personas' documents are full portraits of the same people Vision names in one line. Personas leads: Vision's personas become pointers to Personas' documents, and new people are added in Personas.
activity: Proposed by an agent on W-31
